02 / AWE & BEAUTY

Beauty is an invitation to notice.

Beauty can interrupt distraction and help us appreciate the world around us. In this living garden, each small act of attention creates growth—a reminder to slow down, notice what is beautiful, and care for what matters.

BEHIND THE WORK

Why a sculpture
made of light?

Each point is small on its own. Together, they create a shape—just as choices, relationships, questions, and acts of kindness shape a life.

The sculpture transforms instead of settling into one final form. The thread suggests an interconnected identity. The unfinished circle leaves room for doubt. Ripples suggest the reach of service.

This sample uses Christian themes of dignity, questioning, love of neighbor, and renewal. The writing is a starting point, not a statement of Ben’s personal beliefs. Replace it with your own experiences and the sources your class requires.
